title: Key Appointments & Redevelopment Decisions
summary:
*   The Austin Redevelopment Corporation is set to begin winding down its operations over the next six months.
*   New members were appointed to the Boards of Directors for both the Austin Redevelopment Corporation and the Austin Inner City Redevelopment Corporation.
*   Andrew Martin was appointed as the new General Counsel for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
transcript:
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
February 23, 1995
The meeting was called to order at 3:33 p.m. Present: Bruce Todd, Max Nofziger, Gus
Garcia, Ronney Reynolds, Brigid Shea, Jackie Goodman, Eric Mitchell
Absent:
==
==
Agenda Item No. 51 (1) Approve Minutes of December 15, 1994, meeting. Motion The Board, on
Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Brigid Shea's second approved the
Resolution on a 5-0-0 vote with Board Members Jackie Goodman and Eric Mitchell out of the
room.
Agenda Item No. 52 (2) Approve a resolution to appoint Andrew Martin as General Counsel of
the Austin Housing Finance Corporation.
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Max Nofziger's second
approved the resolution on a 5-0-0 vote with Board Members Jackie Goodman and Eric
Mitchell out of the room.
Agenda Item No. 53 (3) Approve a resolution to reappoint Vicky Valdez Gomez, and appoint
Oscar Rodriguez, Martin Gonzalez and Bill Cook to the Board of Directors of the Austin
Redevelopment Corporation for a three year term. Motion The Board, on Board Member Max
Nofziger's motion and Board Member Gus Garcia's second approved the resolution on a 5-0-0
vote with Board Members Jackie Goodman and Brigid Shea out of the room. Approved with
intent that the business affairs of the corporation would be wound down in six months. •
MINUTES OF THE
AUSTIN HOUSING CORPORATION
BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
FEBRUARY 23, 1995
CONTINUED
Agenda Item No. 54 (4) Approve a resolution to appoint Oscar Rodriguez, Bill Cook, Martin
Gonzalez, and David Saling to the Board of Directors of the Austin Inner City
Redevelopment Corporation as Class A Directors for such terms as is provided in the
Bylaws.
Motion
The Board, on Board Member Gus Garcia's motion and Board Member Max Nofziger's second
approved the resolution on a 5-0-0 vote with Board Members Jackie Goodman and Brigid Shea
out of the room.
The meeting was adjourned at 3:41 p.m.
